flows.title: Turn text into speech
steps: Type or paste your text into the input box on the Text to Speech page.
Select the voice you want from your Voices at the bottom left of the screen.
Optionally modify the voice settings for the output you want.
Click Generate to create the audio file.
Writing numbers and symbols out as words gives the model less to interpret, which the guide recommends for multilingual models especially.

flows.title: Find a voice in the Voice Library and keep it
steps: Click Voices in the sidebar and select Explore.

Browse the handpicked collections, sort by Trending, Latest, Most users or Character usage, and narrow with the filters for language, accent, category, gender, age, notice period, live moderation and quality.
Click the + button on a voice to keep it in My Voices. A voice kept from the Voice Library does not use a custom voice slot.
In My Voices, click the T button on a voice to open Text to Speech with that voice already selected.
